cards.title: Anthropic IPOs as GTA VI Proves Efficiency Isn't Everything
cards.body: Anthropic entered the public market on the same day Grand Theft Auto VI became one of entertainment's most successful launches ever. The timing highlights the tension between AI-driven efficiency and painstaking human craftsmanship.

cards.title: S&P Eyes Nvidia Credit Downgrade Over Governance Risks
cards.body: The credit rating agency is considering lowering Nvidia's rating to AA-, the fourth-highest tier. The move reflects concerns about governance and 'key man' risks at the chip giant.

cards.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work With Single Usage Meter
cards.body: OpenAI will combine ChatGPT Chat and Work experiences under one unified usage tracker. Heavy users may hit limits sooner under the new consolidated system.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Broke Nvidia's Own Code of Conduct
cards.body: Nvidia's founder violated the company's code of conduct, with potential consequences for corporate culture. The breach highlights how company policies reflect and shape leadership accountability.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Defends AI Autonomy Stance as 'Absurd' Accusation
cards.body: Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals claiming he favors surrendering human agency to AI. This comes as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys for Five Years
cards.body: New York prohibited AI chatbot toys citing safety failures including inappropriate content exposure and emotional development risks. Research from Common Sense Media revealed troubling issues with the products.

cards.title: State AGs Challenge Character.AI's User Data Auction
cards.body: Character.ai's bankruptcy sale includes private chats from 21 million U.S. accounts, with 2.1 million belonging to minors. State attorneys general are contesting the sensitive data sale.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Harder to Build, Neoclouds Struggle
cards.body: Nvidia won't backstop data centers until nearly operational, pressuring neoclouds facing construction delays and expensive debt. Land, power, and finished buildings now matter more than pitch decks.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta Discuss Lifting Muse AI Agent Blockade
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to end a two-month blockade of Muse, Meta's AI agent. The potential deal could restore access to the contested AI assistant.

cards.title: Investigators Probe Nvidia's Megaspeed Chip Dealings
cards.body: Questions remain about what Nvidia knew regarding Megaspeed chip destinations and whether Huang's affair with an executive raised red flags. Investigators are examining potential conflicts of interest.

cards.title: Yale Expert Calls Nvidia a 'Detriment' to US Industrial Might
cards.body: Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that Jensen Huang's return as CEO and board member could prove disastrous for the company. He raises concerns about historic personal liability and growing lawsuits.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Rejects Succession Planning as 'Unnecessary Hierarchy'
cards.body: Nvidia's founder opposes formal succession planning despite recent leadership turmoil at the company. His stance comes after weeks of uncertainty without clear leadership structure.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Thanks White House, Says He's in Therapy
cards.body: Huang apologized to Nvidia staff and expressed gratitude for a second chance to lead. The founder disclosed he's undergoing therapy during the all-hands meeting.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Struggle With Everyday Tasks
cards.body: A new benchmark shows even state-of-the-art AI models fail to reliably complete daily tasks safely. The findings raise concerns as millions adopt personal AI assistants.

cards.title: Walmart Brings Black Friday Deals to Meta's Muse Agent
cards.body: Walmart now enables customers to shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta's AI agent. The partnership expands retail access to the AI assistant.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Encrypted AI Data Protection
cards.body: The startup built encrypted AI architecture preventing even the company from accessing users' private data. Maple's approach prioritizes data protection in AI products.

cards.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price in Worrying Sign
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO stock slump raises concerns about AI startup valuations. The decline signals market skepticism about AI company fundamentals.

cards.title: UK Warns AI-Driven Cyberattacks Exploit Weak Security Foundations
cards.body: British cyber agencies warn that AI hacking tools exploit simple security flaws exposed over years. The alert emphasizes building strong security foundations as urgent.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Assistant Directly Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Users no longer need to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app to interact with the AI. The integration streamlines access to Meta's AI assistant.

cards.title: Tidal Bans Fully AI-Generated Tracks Amid AI Slop Surge
cards.body: Tidal will remove millions of AI-generated tracks while still accepting AI-assisted songs. The move addresses the explosion of low-quality AI content flooding streaming platforms.

cards.title: Next-gen bionic hands restore sense of touch
cards.body: Advanced prosthetics wired to nerves now let users feel pressure and handle delicate objects. This breakthrough restores tactile feedback lost after limb amputation.

cards.title: AI data centers drive natural gas boom
cards.body: Rising electricity demands from AI are intensifying reliance on natural gas infrastructure. Data centers are increasingly building their own gas power plants to bypass grid delays.

cards.title: AI strains America's public records systems
cards.body: AI-driven demand for public records is overwhelming small town administrative resources. Towns like Panton, Vermont face unprecedented data access requests from venture-backed companies.

cards.title: Philosopher challenges Anthropic's consciousness claims
cards.body: A prominent philosopher disputes Anthropic's argument that AI could be conscious or sentient. The debate centers on how AI consciousness should be evaluated and understood.

cards.title: New AI capabilities graph shows significant improvements
cards.body: METR's report reveals some AI capabilities are improving faster than previously understood. The findings challenge common misconceptions about AI development trajectories.

cards.title: AI may transform theoretical physics research
cards.body: Machine learning tools could fundamentally change how physicists approach theoretical problems. AI's role in physics is shifting from computation to discovery.
